_comment: Octail's own egg. Octail downloads the official TES3MP 0.8.1 Linux server package from GitHub, checks it against a SHA-256 recorded in the script (the project publishes none), adds Debian 12's LuaJIT library (the package links it but doesn't bundle it; apt checks Debian's signatures), keeps server/ (CoreScripts with the players, cells and world) and tes3mp-server-default.cfg on a reinstall, edits that file with the ini parser before every start (port, slots, name, password, master server listing), runs on octail-yolks' Debian image and adds the Ctrl+C stop, the log-only console (the server reads no input), the UDP port start check, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. The server needs no Morrowind files: each player needs their own copy of Morrowind with both expansions and the TES3MP 0.8.1 client.
name: TES3MP (Morrowind multiplayer)
author: eggs@octail.net
description: TES3MP is a free, open-source multiplayer mod for The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind, built on OpenMW. The server runs without the game files; players need Morrowind (with Tribunal and Bloodmoon) and the TES3MP 0.8.1 client.
startup: [ -x ./tes3mp-server.x86_64 ] || { echo "TES3MP is not installed: reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$(pwd)/lib"; exec ./tes3mp-server.x86_64

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TES3MP installation script (Octail): the official 0.8.1 Linux server package from GitHub, checked against the
# SHA-256 recorded here, plus Debian 12's LuaJIT library (the package doesn't bundle it; apt checks Debian's
# signatures). The server needs no Morrowind data: only the players do. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

## TES3MP 0.8.1, the current release (2022). GitHub publishes no checksum for it, so Octail recorded the archive's
## SHA-256 (2026-10-23). A new release needs it updated here (and in CoreScripts' expected version).
VERSION=0.8.1
FILE="tes3mp-server-GNU+Linux-x86_64-release-0.8.1-68954091c5-6da3fdea59.tar.gz"
SHA256=106a56e32a00ff7a92b574fae0e25671e90a199f509b16d483a8d7da6fc3bcf0

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl tar gzip ca-certificates > /dev/null

if [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: this egg installs TES3MP's Linux x86_64 server (this node is $(uname -m))."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
DL=/mnt/server/.tes3mp-download.tar.gz
URL="https://github.com/TES3MP/TES3MP/releases/download/tes3mp-${VERSION}/tes3mp-server-GNU%2BLinux-x86_64-release-0.8.1-68954091c5-6da3fdea59.tar.gz"
echo "Downloading ${FILE} from GitHub"
if ! curl -fSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 1800 --retry 3 -o "$DL" "$URL"; then
    rm -f "$DL"
    echo "Installation failed: the download from GitHub failed."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "${SHA256}  ${DL}" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    rm -f "$DL"
    echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match TES3MP ${VERSION}'s checksum."
    exit 1
fi

rm -rf /mnt/server/.tes3mp-unpack
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.tes3mp-unpack
U=/mnt/server/.tes3mp-unpack/TES3MP-server
tar -xzf "$DL" -C /mnt/server/.tes3mp-unpack --exclude='TES3MP-server/_deps' \
    --exclude='TES3MP-server/source.tar.gz' --exclude='TES3MP-server/server/.git'
rm -f "$DL"
if [ ! -f "$U/tes3mp-server.x86_64" ] || [ ! -f "$U/tes3mp-server-default.cfg" ]; then
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.tes3mp-unpack
    echo "Installation failed: tes3mp-server is missing from ${FILE}."
    exit 1
fi

## the server's own files are replaced; server/ (CoreScripts with your players, cells, world and custom scripts) and
## tes3mp-server-default.cfg (your settings) are kept when they exist
if [ -d server ]; then
    rm -rf "$U/server"
else
    mv "$U/server" .
fi
if [ -f tes3mp-server-default.cfg ]; then
    rm -f "$U/tes3mp-server-default.cfg"
fi
rm -rf lib resources
cp -a "$U"/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/.tes3mp-unpack
chmod +x tes3mp-server.x86_64

## LuaJIT 2.1, which the server links (libluajit-5.1.so.2), from Debian 12: apt verifies the package
mkdir -p /tmp/luajit
cd /tmp/luajit
apt-get download -qq libluajit-5.1-2 > /dev/null
dpkg-deb -x libluajit-5.1-2_*.deb root
LIB=$(find root -name 'libluajit-5.1.so.2*' -type f | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$LIB" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: LuaJIT isn't in Debian's libluajit-5.1-2 package."
    exit 1
fi
cp -f "$LIB" /mnt/server/lib/libluajit-5.1.so.2
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf /tmp/luajit

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: TES3MP ${VERSION}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the TES3MP server browser (up to 64 characters).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = anyone can join. No spaces.

variables.name: Public Server List
variables.description: true lists the server on the TES3MP master server (the browser in the client); false keeps it off the list (players join by address).
